newsitem.title: USA: BolsWessanen buys Ready Foods from Dean.
newsitem.headline: BolsWessanen buys Ready Foods from Dean.

text.p: Dutch food and drinks group Koninklijke BolsWessanen NV said Tuesday that Crowley Foods Inc., its eastern dairy division in the United States, will acquire Ready Foods Inc. of Philadelphia, a subsidiary of Dean Foods Inc.
BolsWessanen, based in the Netherlands, said Ready Foods generates $25 million sales and has 85 employees.
With this transaction, Crowley Foods broadens its manufacturing capabilities and product range from fresh dairy products and ice cream to ultra pasteurized extended shelf life dairy products.
Dean Foods was not immediately available for comment.
Dean's stock rose 37.5 cents to $27.50 on the New York Stock Exchange in late trading.
